name: Engineering
does: Designs the robot's structure and mechanisms, and tests ideas on paper and in CAD before anything is cut.

name: Manufacturing
does: Cuts, drills, machines, and assembles the parts, then keeps the robot repaired between matches.

name: Programming
does: Writes the code that drives the robot, from driver controls to the routine that runs on its own at the start of a match.

name: Media and PR
does: Photographs, films, and writes the team's story for social media, sponsors, and competition judges.

name: Business
does: Plans the budget, finds and thanks sponsors, and organizes outreach and fundraising.
